name: Nova DSO Tracker
tagline: Real-time tracking and planning for Deep Space Objects.
description: Nova DSO Tracker is a tool for astrophotographers to track Deep Space Objects, check observability, and manage imaging sessions.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  nova:
    image: mrantonsg/nova-dso-tracker:7.0.0@sha256:5efe5e04cb9e3f9a4aa9ac5aae3bf8bb0025bea7684c6bc9b002ecbe3665b029
    container_name: big-bear-nova-dso-tracker
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:5001"
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/instance:/app/instance
    restart: unless-stopped
    network_mode: bridge
